updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection policies at the network layer, blocking sensitive data exfiltration to untrusted cloud apps, generative AI platforms, and social media. This network-layer enforcement complements traditional endpoint DLP and helps admins reduce insider risk and uncontrolled SaaS usage.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authenticated attacker can exploit weak authorization controls in Microsoft Exchange Server to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should apply available patches immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Upgraded DLP inline protection for Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business now integrates with Conditional Access grant controls and supports expanded policy conditions, multiple activities per rule, and activity explorer visibility. This streamlines configuration and gives admins finer-grained control over data protection enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
updates.summary: Purview audit logs will now provide enhanced visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions when users access the portal, helping admins troubleshoot authorization issues and monitor who can access what. This improves compliance visibility and access governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Admins can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same labels configured for Microsoft 365 groups and sites, extending classification and governance without separate configuration. This simplifies label management and closes governance gaps for identity-based grouping.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
updates.summary: Admins can now export DLP policies and label publishing policies as downloadable ZIP files including schema, streamlining troubleshooting by enabling quick attachment to support cases. This reduces resolution time for policy-related issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling organizations to classify and protect more at-rest data faster. This helps close labeling gaps and prepares data estates for Copilot with better protection coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP for Intune Mobile Application Management-protected Apps
updates.summary: Purview DLP now extends to Intune MAM-protected mobile apps, evaluating clipboard actions and content-aware protection policies on mobile devices before allowing data sharing. Admins can also use Purview Collection policies to govern sensitive data on mobile workflows, reducing mobile data leakage risk.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) support for DLP in SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Purview DLP now detects sensitive content embedded in images (JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, PDF) in SharePoint Online and OneDrive, applying DLP policies to prevent image-based data exfiltration. This closes a common data loss vector where sensitive information is obscured as images.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers policy compliance report
updates.summary: Admins can now generate Information Barriers policy compliance reports identifying SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes. This improves visibility into regulatory drift and helps track remediation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Note capabilities in alerts and cases
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now allows analysts to add notes directly within alerts and automatically records system-generated notes (e.g., status changes, assignments), centralizing investigation history and audit trails. This improves collaboration and maintains clear records of investigation progress.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Enhanced user profile in Insider Risk Management alerts
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management alerts now display enriched user profile attributes (employee type, office location, start date, policy inclusion, priority user status, last working day) within the alert workflow. Investigators gain critical context without leaving their alert interface, accelerating risk assessments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Block all connected experiences with sensitivity labels in Office apps
updates.summary: The 'Prevent connected experiences that analyze content' sensitivity label setting now blocks files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint from being sent to all Microsoft connected experience services for analysis, not just a subset. This gives admins stricter control over data exposure to cloud analysis services.
